QuestInfo.name: Defeat Stump Spooks
QuestInfo.0: A Stump Spook has been seen at the Xuanshan Mountain Vantage.
QuestInfo.1: Yun Wu was correct. It's bad that monsters like that are appearing so close to the Xuanshan School... You should remove it before it threatens your young pupils.
QuestInfo.2:
You discovered new skills while defeating the Stump Spooks. 
Still, it's strange for them to appear so near to the school.
